THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Declaration under Section 5

BY virtue of Sub-section (1) of Section 5 of the Land Acquisition Act, I, Kuragamage Don Lal Kantha, Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation, do hereby declare that the lands speciﬁ ed below are required for a public purpose and will be acquired under the provisions of the Land Acquisition Act.

Allotments of land depicted in the Tracing No. R/PLM/2023/841 dated 06.11.2023 prepared by the Surveyor General, situated in the Village called Narangoda F.V.P. 205A in No. 167, Grama Niladhari Division of Ganegama, in the Divisional Secretary's Division of Pelmadulla in Ratnapura District of Sabaragamuwa Province and bounded as follows.:
01. Lot ‘A’ – Ambagahaliyadda, Pareykumbura, Pin Aswedduma, Arambekumbura, Dolisigekumbura, Radagoda - Extent: 2.4942 Hectares
North: A portion of Lot No. 26 of F.V.P. 205A and Kuttapitiya Village; East: A portion of Lot No. 26 of F.V.P. 205A and Lot
No. 5; South: Lot B and a portion of Lot No. 26 of F.V.P. 205A; West: Lot B and a portion of Lot No. 26 of F.V.P. 205A.
02. Lot ‘B’ – Pareykumbura, Pin Aswedduma, Radagoda - Extent: 0.1716 Hectare

North: Lot A; East: Lot A and Lot No. 5 of F.V.P. 205A; South: Lot Nos. 21,17 and 16 of F.V.P. 205A; West: Lot Nos. 17 and 16 of F.V.P. 205A and a portion of Lot No. 26 of F.V.P. 205A. K.D. Lൺඅ Kൺඇඍඁൺ, Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation.

Land Acquisition Act (Chapter 460) as amended by the Land Acquision (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964 Declaration under Section 5
My No.: 03J/73/E/280'Divisional Secretary's Ref No.: PLDS/LND/04/ACQ/07(ii).
I, Kuragamage Don Lal Kantha, Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation, have erroneously published

a Declaration under Section 5 concerning the Tracing No. R/PLM/2014/401 dated 27.11.2014 in the Gazette Extraordinary No. 2310/10 dated 12.12.2022 of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka, which should be replaced with the Declaration under Section 5 concerning the Tracing No. R/PLM/2023/841 dated 06.11.2023. Accordingly, by virtue of Section 18 of the Interpretation Ordinance (Chapter 12) as amended by the Interpretation (Amendment) Act No. 18 of 1972 and Interpretation (Amendment) Act No. 29 of 1974, I do hereby revoke the Declaration under Section 5 concerning the Tracing No. R/PLM/2014/401 dated 27.11.2014 in the Gazette Extraordinary No. 2310/10 dated 12.12.2022 of Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka.
K.D. Lൺඅ Kൺඇඍඁൺ, Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation.
